column1: # Retrospective validation set, version 1 — ACTION TO CHASSIS MAPPING
# THIS FILE IS THE REASON THE TEST CAN MEAN ANYTHING.
# Published campaigns do things like "overexpress PDI" or "disrupt PMR1". The
# chassis emits engineered MODULES. Scoring requires a rule connecting the two,
# and if that rule is written AFTER the answers are read, every near-miss gets
# argued into a hit and the test proves nothing.
# So the mapping is frozen here, before any outcome is extracted, and it is
# committed in the same commit as the predictions.
# The unmapped rows matter most. Each one is a campaign action the chassis has no
# way to express. They are declared now as GUARANTEED MISSES. Pre-committing to
# that is the difference between a test and a sales pitch.
# COLUMNS
#   action        the category of thing a campaign did
#   maps_to       the chassis module or capability that would count as naming it
#   basis         why that mapping is defensible, quoting the chassis object
# action
column3: basis

column1: PDI overexpression
column3: parts_required includes "ER chaperone overexpression"

column1: BiP / Kar2 overexpression
column3: parts_required includes "ER chaperone overexpression"

column1: Other ER chaperone (Ssa1, Ydj1, Sec63)
column3: parts_required includes "ER chaperone overexpression"

column1: UPR regulator HAC1
column3: parts_required names "UPR regulator HAC1"

column1: Signal peptide or leader engineering
column3: parts_required names "signal peptide selection"

column1: Gene dosage or copy-number tuning
column3: parts_required names "gene dosage tuning"

column1: OCH1 or ALG3 knockout
column3: parts_required names "OCH1 knockout"

column1: Glycosyltransferase addition
column3: parts_required names "GlcNAc transferase I and II, galactosyltransferase"

column1: Mannosidase addition
column3: parts_required names "alpha-1,2-mannosidase"

column1: Sugar-nucleotide pathway or transporter
column3: parts_required names "UDP-GlcNAc pathway enzymes" and the Golgi transporters

column1: Inducible or switchable module expression
column3: parts_required names "inducible promoter per module"

column1: Assembly or integration strategy for a long CDS
column3: parts_required names "assembly strategy, integration locus choice"

column1: # UNMAPPED — DECLARED MISSES BEFORE THE ANSWERS ARE READ
PMR1 disruption
column3: No capability covers Golgi calcium handling or the protease consequences of its loss. The chassis cannot name this.

column1: Protease deletion other than PMR1
column3: B7 "protease balance" exists but is marked native and always-required, so it is never emitted as something to engineer. It cannot be scored as a prediction.

column1: Temperature, heat shock or cultivation condition
column3: G4 "culture conditions" is native and always-required. The chassis treats process conditions as given, not designed.

column1: Vesicle trafficking or SNARE engineering
column3: No capability covers post-Golgi trafficking as a separate step. E3 lumps all of secretion together.

column1: Point mutation of the product itself
column3: The chassis takes the sequence as fixed input. Redesigning the product is outside what it can propose.

column1: Promoter or terminator choice
column3: A2 "promoter function in host" is native and always-required, so no promoter is ever proposed.

column1: Host species change
column3: The chassis is defined on S. cerevisiae. Switching host is not a move it can make.
